dialect.detail: JMA ORCA (Japan Medical Association standard receipt software) – GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL based medical billing system, program ORAPI023R1V2 (API linkage module for medical fee simulation)
evidence: no EXEC CICS/SQL, uses sequential files with Linux-style paths

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (claims billing) software – API module for medical fee/claim simulation (shinryou koui simulation)
purpose.summary: This program is part of the JMA ORCA medical receipt software system. It implements an API-linked module (ORAPI023R1V2) for simulating medical fee calculations (shinryou koui simulation), reading parameter files, processing insurance combinations, and producing XML-based API responses for medical billing claims. It coordinates with numerous copybooks covering patient master, fee master, work treatment action records, and collection calculation.

notable_features: Japanese comments encoded in latin-1 (EUC-JP/Shift-JIS garbled)
LINKAGE SECTION with MCP area and ORCA-SPA
No COMP-3, no EXEC SQL, no EXEC CICS
Sequential file I/O for parameter files
OCCURS tables for insurance combinations and treatment actions
verdict.notes: File is encoded in latin-1 but contains Japanese text (EUC-JP or Shift-JIS) that appears garbled under latin-1 decoding. This is characteristic of JMA ORCA source files. The program is clearly production-grade medical billing software, not a demo or student exercise. Source is truncated at 16000 chars but sufficient evidence is present for classification.
